verdict.rationale: Brex explicitly advertises 'AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments' and GL coding automation, which aligns with reading bills and populating payment details for review. However, this is a single marketing claim with no technical documentation on how bill data is extracted, no API endpoint evidence for this specific flow, and no independent/hands-on corroboration (community discussion instead centers on separate AI trust concerns unrelated to invoice automation). Missing for 10: technical docs/API details on invoice-reading AI, hands-on or independent verification that it works as claimed, and explicit 'review before payment' workflow evidence.
